ابتدئ (form VIII)
# اُبْتُدِئَ (ubtudiʔa) /ub.tu.di.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِبْتَدَأَ (ibtadaʔa)
# اِبْتَدِئْ (ibtadiʔ) /ib.ta.diʔ/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِبْتَدَأَ (ibtadaʔa)
